name: nickai-outcome-xyz-demo
about: NickAI x outcome.xyz integration walkthrough (Oct 2026). Source: 3050x2064 window recording, ~10 min. Part 1 trades outcome.xyz markets by chat, part 2 builds the BTC Daily Edge workflow (sped up ~8x).
music_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Modern minimal deep-house / downtempo electronic bed for a fintech product demo, 118 BPM, warm analog synth pads, soft plucked arpeggio, subtle sidechained kick and light hats, steady and confident, uncluttered midrange so a voiceover sits on top. Gentle 4-second fade-in, consistent energy throughout with a small lift halfway, clean ending. Duration about 4 minutes 30 seconds.

intro.title: Prediction markets on Hyperliquid,
intro.sub: Live outcome.xyz account · real orders · every trade approved by you

bridge.title: Automate it with a workflow

outro.title: Talk to outcome.xyz.
outro.fine: Trading involves risk. Not financial advice.

lines.L00: This is NickAI, now integrated with outcome.xyz, the prediction markets on Hyperliquid. Everything you'll see is a live account, driven by chat.
lines.L01: First, what's live on outcome.xyz? Nick pulls the markets, ranked by volume.
lines.L02: The BTC daily market, with live odds and price history, right in the chat.
lines.L03: The next Fed decision: Nick shows the odds and explains exactly how it resolves.
lines.L04: How much can I buy before slippage? Nick walks the order book and gives me a practical read.
lines.L05: My balance, straight from my Hyperliquid wallet.
lines.L06: Now let's trade. Ten Yes shares on the BTC daily, at market.
lines.L06b: Nick prepares the order, I approve, and it fills. There's the position on outcome.xyz.
lines.L07: A limit buy for twenty No shares at five cents. Nick flags that it's far below the market before I approve.
lines.L07b: And it's resting on the book on outcome.xyz.
lines.L08: Show my open orders, then cancel that one. One message.
lines.L09: My positions with P&L: average fill, current mark, and unrealized P&L.
lines.L10: Sell everything at market. Approve, filled, and the transaction is right there on Hyperliquid.
lines.B0: Now, what if this should run on its own? Let's turn it into a workflow.
lines.W1: I describe a strategy in plain English. Every fifteen minutes, check BTC's price on Hyperliquid and today's BTC daily market on outcome.xyz.
lines.W2: Estimate the fair odds. If they beat the market by more than eight points, buy Yes, or No if it's the other way, and message me on Telegram.
lines.W3: Nick picks the nodes and wires them on the canvas: outcome.xyz market data, a pricing function, the order nodes, and Telegram.
lines.W4: Then it validates the workflow and checks the math before handing it back.
lines.W5: Built and validated: ten nodes, eleven edges. Add a Telegram bot, and switch it on.
lines.O2: Prediction markets you can talk to, and automate. outcome.xyz, now on NickAI. Try it for free now at getnick.ai.
